performance.cable-capacity-basis: Cat6 24AWG (6.1 mm) cables at 100 % fill, theoretical; 17 at the recommended 30 % - FS 0U/1U Horizontal Cable Manager datasheet table, and the Cable Capacity Reference Guide of the Horizontal Cable Managers with D-rings datasheet

physical.mounting-hardware: M6*15mm Screw x4 and M6 Nut x4

configs.description: The cable manager as FS ships #120680, five rings fitted.
configs.name: base

gaps.wanted: no bays and no grouped ports to correlate against, so there is nothing to wire yet - group the ports first - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
a port the DCIM export types as an interface - a placement in a group whose role is a port role, with media and speed it maps - unlocks interfaces on the NetBox / Nautobot device type

attrs.note: datasheet - the weight, the ring material, the mounting hardware and "Indoor" are the 0U/1U datasheet's table; "Steel, Powder-coated Black" for the panel is the D-rings datasheet's.

cable-capacity.note: datasheet - "Cable Capacity (Theoretical Value) 55pcs (Cat6 24AWG)" in the 0U/1U datasheet's table, and 55 Cat6 24AWG 6.1 mm cables at 100 % fill, 17 at the recommended 30 %, in the D-rings datasheet's Cable Capacity Reference Guide. Stated once, here, and not divided among the rings.

chassis.note: drawing - 430 x 44 x 97.7. The plate is flat over the whole 19 in [482.6mm] and its top and bottom edges fold back over 16.93 in [430mm], 1.04 in [26.3mm] in from each end; the flat ends outside the folds are the ears, which this library does not draw, so the body is the 430. Both datasheets' tables give the depth as 3.37 in (85.5 mm): the D-rings datasheet's side view shows that this is the ring from the face of the plate, and dimensions 3.85 in [97.7mm] from the back of the folded edges to the front of the ring, which is the envelope.

color.note: estimated - "Steel, Powder-coated Black" and "Color: Black". Every image FS publishes of the part is a render.

ears.note: drawing - `positions` states where the ears bolt, for the Rack Builder. The ears are the flat ends of the panel, so the ear plane is the panel face, and the rings stand 85.5 mm in front of it (the vendor's side view, datasheet page 4, 3.37 in [85.5mm]). `at` is 85.5. Of the 97.7 depth, 12.2 stands behind the rail. This states a placement; no dimension changed.

front.note: drawing - the front view of the D-rings datasheet: the plate between the folds and the five rings on their seats. Rings centred 35 mm from the left fold and 90 apart: the drawing dimensions 1.04 in [26.3mm] plus 1.38 in [35.1mm] to the first ring's centre and 3.54 in [90mm] between centres, and the five read 90.0 mm apart, symmetric about the middle. The ring's contract has the rest. FS's mark, printed on the plate just inside the left fold, is not drawn: a vendor mark never is.

full-depth.note: `full-depth: false` - the rings stand 85.5 mm in front of the panel and the panel's folded edges reach only 12.2 behind it (the vendor's side view), so the rear face of its rack unit stays free for another part (#854).

left.note: drawing - an elevation, the D-rings datasheet's side view: the folded edges behind the plate and the ring's profile in front of it, without its bracing. The right is the same, turned round.

method.note: FIGURES FIRST, FROM THE VENDOR'S OWN DIMENSIONED DRAWINGS. Two FS datasheets draw the part. The Horizontal Cable Managers with D-rings datasheet has a side view and a front view dimensioned in inches with millimetres in brackets: the front view is 2.161 px/mm across from the 482.6 line (1043 px) and 2.205 down from the 44 (97 px), a 2 % difference between the axes, and its 430, 90 and 35.1 lines agree with the across scale to under a millimetre. FS's 0U/1U Horizontal Cable Manager datasheet draws the same part with 482.4, 465, 31.5 and 97.4; the 0.3 mm between the two is drawing, not part, and the D-rings datasheet's figures are taken.

rear.note: photo-measured - the back of the plate, plain, as FS's render of the back (gallery image 2) shows it: the ring seats' backs and the folded edges and nothing else. The seats' backs are not drawn.

thickness.note: estimated - 1.2 mm, the sheet FS dimensions on the CMH-4DRB1U drawing of the D-rings datasheet. No view of this part dimensions its sheet.

top.note: drawing - an elevation: the folded edge behind the plate, and the five rings' top members from above. The bottom is the same from underneath, where each ring's bottom member stops short of its curled foot.
